title: Open Seminar; Adaptations in Latine/x Texts and Films
description: Explores representations of Latines/xs/as/os across historical moments and cultural texts to gain a wide-view of sociopolitical movements, identity formations, and representational strategies. We will pay special attention to adaptations of Latine/x images, tropes, and texts in historical and discursive contexts. Seeks to examine the field through interdisciplinary and intersectional critical / theoretical lenses. Readings mostly in English; class discussions and written work in Spanish/English. Expect to work on a digital storytelling project.
